description: Trait de côte de 2011-2012 en Pays de la Loire (côtes sableuses) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by doi.org. Polyline digitized from aerial images fixing the position of the coastline along the sandy coasts of the Pays de la Loire region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal feature of 2011-2012 in Pays de la Loire (sandy coasts)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
